successors.name: Kingdom of Sardinia
successors.text: All of it, annexed on 22 March 1860 after the plebiscites of 11 March 1860

ledger.x: December 1859: the union of central Italy is formed.
December 1859: the Papal Legations of Romagna join the union.
March 1860: the United Provinces end in annexation to the Kingdom of Sardinia, which becomes the Kingdom of Italy on 17 March 1861.

wars.name: Second Italian War of Independence
wars.outcome: The Franco-Sardinian victory over Austria in 1859 let the central Italian states expel their rulers; the United Provinces were annexed by Sardinia on 22 March 1860.

certainty.note: The state is the union of four states whose frontiers were the old ones; the Legations' limit toward the Marche is the papal frontier, which no page opened describes.
